families.title: Input and player actions
families.scope: run, slow walk, turn, jump, kick, abdomen bounce, slide, spin, berry throw, swinging, and manual camera input
families.priority_basis: Core producer of player, physics, animation, combat, plant, camera, and audio state transitions.

families.title: Player lifecycle
families.scope: health, damage, invulnerability, shields, powers, death, checkpoints, lives, game over, and continue
families.priority_basis: Session-owned state crosses player actions, hazards, HUD, frontend persistence, death, reload, and scene transition.

families.title: Movement and world physics
families.scope: gravity, slopes, ledges, floors, walls, hazards, movers, air states, collision response, and camera collision
families.priority_basis: Collision and integration are shared consumers of almost every actor, traversal power, mover, hazard, and camera path.

families.title: Rendering, camera, and animation
families.scope: world and actor submission, ordering tables, double buffering, materials, effects, models, animation, and normal or special cameras
families.priority_basis: Shared presentation substrate for every world, actor, effect, HUD-adjacent, and scene-residency conclusion.

families.title: Seeds, plants, and traversal powers
families.scope: every color and tier, carry, mount, plant, uproot, mushroom, propeller, dandelion, cannon, leaf platforms, temporary powers, shooters, mines, and combinations
families.priority_basis: Depends on core action, physics, object, render, and audio substrates; high unresolved and variant breadth follows those shared campaigns.

families.title: Collectibles, equipment, and rewards
families.scope: grain, FLIK letters, health leaves, berries, seed tokens, telescope, grain harvester, success tokens, medals, unlocks, and bonus entries
families.priority_basis: Reward state consumes object, combat, audio, HUD, persistence, and transition contracts and needs stage-wide pickup breadth.

families.title: Objects, events, and hazards
families.scope: contacts, pickups, props, gates, switches, movers, dynamic geometry, scripted actors, event VM, objectives, and environmental hazards
families.priority_basis: Shared allocation, dispatch, scripted-event, and hazard substrate used by collectibles, enemies, bosses, and stage objectives.

families.title: Enemies and combat
families.scope: every regular family and variant, AI, attacks, immunities, damage, death, drops, respawn, permanent kills, and quotas
families.priority_basis: Family-specific campaigns depend on the shared player, object, render, collision, audio, and reward contracts.

families.title: Bosses and special objectives
families.scope: Thumper, Bird, Thud, Molt, Hopper, flight and chase, rolling arena, bird assembly, companion rescue, finale mechanics, Training, campaign stages, and bonus objectives
families.priority_basis: Special objectives compose the shared substrates and family-specific mechanics, so they follow rather than replace those campaigns.

families.title: HUD, frontend, and persistence
families.scope: status, pause, results, menus, options, remapping, save and load, continue, game over, movie viewer, and unlock persistence
families.priority_basis: Consumes shared lifecycle, audio, loading, reward, results, and persistence state; frontend lifecycle remains a carried Phase-3 blocker.

families.title: Audio and cinematics
families.scope: SFX, voices, XA and music selection, FMV playback, skip and error paths, ownership, pause, stop, and transition behavior
families.priority_basis: Shared audio substrate is consumed by every active gameplay family; cinematic paths also cross frontend and loading ownership.

families.title: Loading, overlays, and resources
families.scope: scene flow, level and MEMORY or FMV overlays, streaming, loader fixups, asset residency, unload, and failure paths
families.priority_basis: Shared scene and asset residency substrate constrains every stage, overlay-specific subsystem, frontend transition, and cinematic path.
